title: Actions File Serialization Format
description: JSON Schema for the canonical serialization of .actions files. Field names mirror the v4 actions ontology (https://clearhead.us/vocab/actions/v4) minus the 'has' prefix, so a single grep connects a serialized field to its ontology property and its .actions DSL token.

name.description: The decoded semantic title, after DSL escapes are removed.

description.description: Decoded long-form description — '$ ... $' in the DSL.

scheduledDateTime.description: '@' in the DSL. ISO 8601 local date/time when the Action is planned to be worked. Intent only: it bounds nothing and is not inherited (Decision 48).

dueDateTime.description: ':' in the DSL. The Action's window: an ISO 8601 local date/time (a deadline), or an ISO 8601 interval `start/end` (a lower bound and a deadline). A bound covers its written precision. Effective bounds inherited from ancestors are derived and are not serialized here.

completedDateTime.description: '%' in the DSL. ISO 8601 completion time.

createdDateTime.description: '^' in the DSL. ISO 8601 creation time.

charter.description: Decoded charter membership hint — '*' in the DSL.

sequentialChildren.description: '~' in the DSL. When true, each child implicitly depends on the previous sibling completing.

predecessors.description: Dependency references — '<' in the DSL. A canonical UUID or unresolved alias is preserved as semantic reference text.

externalScheduleId.description: External schedule-series identifier (e.g. an ICS UID).

externalOccurrenceKey.description: External occurrence-level identifier within a series.

parentId.description: UUID of the parent action ('>' nesting in the DSL).

children.description: Nested child actions ('>' depth in the DSL).
